sloka: शुशुभे सुभगः श्रीमान् स्वाती पथ इव अम्बरे ।ततो देवाः सगन्धर्वाः सिद्धाः च परम ऋषयः ॥६-२२-७३॥।।
transliteration: śuśubhe subhagaḥ śrīmān svātī patha iva ambare ।tato devāḥ sagandharvāḥ siddhāḥ ca parama ṛṣayaḥ ॥6-22-73॥।।

translations.english: The Gandharvas, gods and even siddhas felt happy and reached their stationed in the sky to see the wonderful bridge.
